verdict.rationale: kitty documents real automation surfaces: remote control from scripts, Python kittens and startup sessions. The pack has no evidence of any built-in way to version, review or roll back those automations. A community note that the config 'fits in a dotfiles repo' is a user-side workaround (external git), not a product capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
